claim_scope: One-shot cross-version confirmation of semantic replay auditing using HIKARI-2021-frozen models on HIKARI-2022; not a claim of universal IDS performance.

sampling.rule: Keep the 50,000 smallest unsigned 64-bit SHA-256 prefixes of 'mad-etd:hikari2022:v1:<zero-based-row-index>'.

group_protocol.group: SHA-256 of the order-invariant originh/responh endpoint pair
group_protocol.role_rule: calibration if SHA-256('mad-etd:hikari2022:role:' + group_hash) is even, otherwise evaluation

feature_policy.model_feature_names: exact names stored in the frozen HIKARI-2021 model wrappers

evaluation.compromised_sources: each of the three sources independently
evaluation.attack: label-aware extreme-wrong probability replacement, preserving the [0,1] contract
evaluation.fusion_before_detection: equal mean of all three locked sources
evaluation.fusion_after_revocation: equal mean of the two non-revoked peers
evaluation.primary_security_metric: harmful flip rate over attacked clean-correct evaluation decisions
secondary_metrics: detection rate with exact 95% binomial interval
paired harmful-rate reduction with bootstrap interval and Wilcoxon test

cost_protocol.reported_scope: locked-model replay inference only; excludes feature retrieval, storage, transport, revocation, and recovery

immutability_rule: Any protocol change after this file is committed to disk requires a new experiment identifier and must not overwrite this result.
